About Bidders Highway

Bidders Highway is an online auction platform for enthusiast and collector cars, founded by enthusiasts for enthusiasts with the ambition that it should be as enjoyable to buy and sell special cars, as it is to own and drive them.

We are based in Stockholm but work with cars across the entirety of Sweden as well as internationally.

Our auctions take place around the clock over 7 days and new listings are constantly being added.

We help sellers to document their auction listings on our platform and then market them to potential buyers around the world.
